title: The retired features' dropped test groups name where their live modules' calls went
goal: A full perfcheck.py dropped run lists 21 historical groups of retired features (autopilot, the headless runner) whose deleted test files imported a live module beside the removed one and whose reasons name no successor (ST-vxi7drn2). Each group's reason in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt is annotated with a phrase the checker recognises, stating that the live module's calls went with the retired feature, and perfcheck's names_successor accepts that phrase only beside a removed module or file the reason names; a full dropped run then warns of none of them, and no known-list is left over. The operator chose this (option a).
